''See also: [[Emperor's crown (Elder Empire) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor's crown is a significant golden artifact from the [[Elder Empire]] that serves as a primary symbol of imperial [[Authority{{!}}authority]]. While historical depictions show the ruler wearing a bronze version, the current iteration is a [[gold circlet]] used by the Emperor to project his status as the founder of human civilization and the icon of a unified empire. [[The crown]] was typically reserved for public addresses and formal appearances rather than daily administrative tasks. As an invested object, the crown possesses immense power derived from the Emperor's concentrated [[Intent]]. This makes it far more potent than standard invested items, capable of exerting a heavy psychological pressure on those nearby. Its primary function is the manipulation of will; when worn, it allows the user to issue commands that carry the weight of absolute [[Authority{{!}}authority]]. While these commands may only feel like suggestions to most, they become impossible for any loyal subject of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] to disobey. Because of this capacity to warp minds and command citizens, the crown is considered a dangerous tool that could allow a [[Great Elder]] to seize control of the world if they were to possess it.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Emperor's crown is a golden artifact utilized by [[Calder Marten]]. This invested object possesses greater power than standard items due to the bound [[Intent]] contained within it. When the crown is [[Awakened]], it grants the wearer the ability to control individuals against their will and can be employed to persuade the [[Consultants]].}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor's crown is a lost [[Imperial relics{{!}}Imperial relic]] crafted by the [[Guild of Magisters{{!}}Magister’s Guild]] with help from [[Regent{{!}}Regent Loreli]]. This [[gold circlet]], which rests upon a velvet lining, holds the Emperor's memories and possesses the power to defend [[Calder]] or soothe allies. While its return would benefit [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]], the object is a prize sought by [[Great Elders]] and potentially the Collector of Souls. [[The crown]] was eventually discovered inside a heavy safe held by a toad creature, and anyone who touches it is overwhelmed by the force of the Emperor's will.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">13</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor’s crown is an item that the Collector of Souls might seek.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A crown is kept in a heavy safe carried by the cook.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
